nameOrigin: moisture often found on grass or plants

pokedexEntries.di: Over the winter, it closes its bud and endures the cold. In spring, the bud opens and releases pollen.

pokedexEntries.prl: It lives alongside clear ponds. It scatters pollen that induces harsh sneezing and runny noses.

pokedexEntries.pt: Sensitive to changing temperature, the bud is said to bloom when it feels the sun’s warm touch.
